description: This file contains unit tests for onboarding remote authentication prompts and related UI logic in a macOS app, specifically testing error mappings, UI element visibility, and user guidance copy.

methods.name: auth detail codes map to remote auth issues
methods.description: Tests mapping of various auth detail codes to remote gateway auth issues.

methods.name: password detail family maps to password required issue
methods.description: Tests mapping of password detail codes to password required issue.

methods.name: token field visibility follows onboarding rules
methods.description: Tests visibility logic for remote token field based on onboarding conditions.

methods.name: pairing required copy points users to pair approve
methods.description: Verifies prompts when device pairing is required.

methods.name: paired device success copy explains auth source
methods.description: Checks copy content when device is successfully paired using different auth sources.

methods.name: transient probe mode restore does not clear probe feedback
methods.description: Ensures UI feedback is preserved when resetting probe mode under certain conditions.
